description: Add RFC4180-style field quoting/escaping to a CSV row builder that currently joins fields with no escaping at all
prompts: csvutil.rb's to_csv_row(fields) just does fields.join(",") - a field containing a comma, a double quote, or a newline corrupts the row. Fix it: a field must be wrapped in double quotes if it contains a comma, a double quote, or a newline (\n); any double quote INSIDE such a field must be escaped by doubling it (" becomes ""); a field with none of those characters stays bare (unquoted). Fields are still joined with commas between them. Do NOT use Ruby's built-in CSV library - implement the escaping directly.

reference_solution.csvutil.rb:
def escape_field(field)
  needs_quoting = field.include?(",") || field.include?('"') || field.include?("\n")
  return field unless needs_quoting

  escaped = field.gsub('"', '""')
  "\"#{escaped}\""
end

def to_csv_row(fields)
  fields.map { |f| escape_field(f) }.join(",")
end

test_setup_files.csvutil_hidden_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "csvutil"

class CsvUtilTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_plain_fields_stay_bare
    assert_equal "a,b,c", to_csv_row(["a", "b", "c"])
  end

  def test_comma_triggers_quoting
    assert_equal '"a,b",c', to_csv_row(["a,b", "c"])
  end

  def test_embedded_quote_is_doubled_and_quoted
    assert_equal '"say ""hi"""', to_csv_row(['say "hi"'])
  end

  def test_newline_triggers_quoting
    assert_equal "\"line1\nline2\"", to_csv_row(["line1\nline2"])
  end

  def test_mixed_row
    row = to_csv_row(["plain", "has,comma", 'has"quote'])
    assert_equal 'plain,"has,comma","has""quote"', row
  end
end
